rawText:
Found 56 items in registries @starseam:

Showing items 1-56 of 56:

- theme (registry:theme) - The token layer — lacquer ground, structural rivets, severity colour, the em grid, and per-language CJK font stacks. Every other item pulls this. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate (registry:ui) - The base surface. One iron plate — no shadow, no glass. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- seam (registry:ui) - The signature: a row of rivets marking where two blocks actually join. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- lames (registry:ui) - A stack of plates, each pressing onto the one below. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- label (registry:ui) - An instrument label — mono, small, widely tracked. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- value (registry:ui) - A readout with tabular figures and a severity state. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- status-dot (registry:ui) - A single rivet standing in for a status. Only critical animates. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mark (registry:ui) - Helmet plan, star chart, radar scope — one mark, three true readings. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- stat-band (registry:ui) - The instrument strip: cells divided by seam lines. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- code-tag (registry:ui) - A mono identifier — a stack item, a version, a CVE. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- code-block (registry:ui) - A plate that holds source code: filename label, copy, a folding seam. Ink shades only — colour is severity, never syntax. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- copy-button (registry:ui) - A quiet text button that puts a value on the clipboard. The confirmation is a rivet, never lapis. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-button (registry:ui) - A cut plate you can press. Square corners, hairline edge, no fill. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button-group (registry:ui) - Buttons riveted into one strip: one hairline frame, seams between the members. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mode-switch (registry:ui) - auto / console (夜勤) / report (日勤). Two materials, not an inversion; the selection is a rivet, never lapis. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-input (registry:ui) - A cut plate you can write into. Focus drives the one blue rivet on the screen. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-textarea (registry:ui) - The long-form plate, set on the body leading rather than the UI one. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- field (registry:ui) - Wires label, control, hint and error together. The error is the only place a field takes colour. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-checkbox (registry:ui) - A checked box is a rivet driven home — steel, not blue. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-switch (registry:ui) - The thumb is a rivet sliding along its seam. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-select (registry:ui) - A list floating on the lightest cut of lacquer. Selection is marked by a rivet. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-dialog (registry:ui) - A plate lifted clear of the page. Riveted seams at the header and footer joins. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-sheet (registry:ui) - A panel drawn out from an edge — the one directional exception to stillness. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-dropdown-menu (registry:ui) - Menu on strong lacquer. Dividers are scored hairlines, not riveted seams. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-tabs (registry:ui) - Tab strip and panel are two plates that meet, so a riveted seam runs between them. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-table (registry:ui) - Rows as lames. Rivets only at the head/body join. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- alert (registry:ui) - A message plate with a severity edge. The colour never stands alone — the title carries the meaning. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- badge (registry:ui) - A stamped status tag: hairline border, no fill. Colour is severity, never decoration. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- kbd (registry:ui) - A key cap: a raised plate the size of a keystroke, pressed metal without a shadow. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- skeleton (registry:ui) - A placeholder plate. It does not shimmer — the only permitted loop belongs to crit. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- avatar (registry:ui) - An identity plate: square, hairline seam, instrument-lettered fallback. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- progress (registry:ui) - A determinate reading in rivet steel. No indeterminate sweep — an endless loop belongs to crit alone. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- breadcrumb (registry:ui) - A path through the structure. Every junction is a real boundary, so the separators are rivets. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pagination (registry:ui) - Page links; the current page is a rivet and full-strength text, never lapis. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-radio-group (registry:ui) - The chosen option holds a rivet driven into its centre. Selection is silver, never lapis. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-slider (registry:ui) - A setting dragged along a seam. Track, range, and thumb are steel; blue appears only as focus. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-toggle (registry:ui) - A pressed-state button. On is a rivet and a deeper fill, never lapis. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-accordion (registry:ui) - Stacked plates that open along their seams; the open item holds a rivet. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-collapsible (registry:ui) - A single section that opens along its seam — the accordion's one-item cousin. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scroll-area (registry:ui) - A viewport with an instrument scrollbar: hairline channel, steel thumb, no floating pill. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-tooltip (registry:ui) - An instrument annotation: the lightest plate, hairline edge, no shadow and no arrow. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-popover (registry:ui) - A small plate lifted beside its trigger. Entry and exit come from the theme. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-hover-card (registry:ui) - A dossier plate raised on hover — the popover's read-only sibling. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-alert-dialog (registry:ui) - The dialog's stricter sibling: an answer is required. Same plate, same seams. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-context-menu (registry:ui) - The dropdown menu summoned at the pointer. Destructive actions take 緋, always with text. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-menubar (registry:ui) - A console menu strip: instrument-lettered triggers, menus falling as dropdown plates. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-command (registry:ui) - The console palette: type, filter, execute. The highlighted row is a rivet, never lapis. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-calendar (registry:ui) - A month on the full-width grid; the selected day is a rivet driven home. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-date-picker (registry:ui) - A calendar in a popover. The date lands in a hidden input — no callback required. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-combobox (registry:ui) - A select with a filter line. Options are data, the value rides a hidden input. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-toast (registry:ui) - Message plates sliding in from the edge. Severity is a coloured seam plus the text itself. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- plate-input-otp (registry:ui) - A code entered one plate at a time. The active slot is edged in lapis because it holds focus. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- highlight (registry:lib) - Server-side ink-layer highlighting: shiki with a shades-only theme wired to the mode-switching CSS variables. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ledger (registry:ui) - An instrument list: labelled entries on one plate, each row cut from the next by a seam. The archetype is a logbook page. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- rail (registry:ui) - A constellation of anchors: one vertical seam, one star per entry, the current one lit via aria-current. Structure only — docking and chrome belong to the consumer. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- glyph (registry:ui) - The glyph set: hairline instrument marks on the 24-unit grid — cut, not moulded. Monochrome, currentColor, never a severity. [@starseam] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
